logo.description: One letter or emoji shown as the logo and favicon.

me.description: Profiles that link back to the site, as rel="me" (verifies the site on Mastodon).

fediverse.description: Fediverse handle credited when a note is shared on Mastodon, e.g.

stages.description: Folder (or `stage` property value) to stage: a preset name, a label of the vault's own, or an icon and a label, either of which may be left out.

publish.description: explicit: only notes with `publish: true`; all: every note except `publish: false`.

privateLinks.description: What a link to a note that is not published shows: text, its words as written; placeholder, a neutral "a private note"; hide, nothing unless the link has an alias.

home.description: Vault-relative note rendered as the home page; `bento` keeps index.md and lays the home out as a dashboard of tiles, which the long form chooses: { note, layout: bento, tiles: [now, recent…] }.

typePrefix.description: Tags starting with this prefix give a note its types, shown as chips.

blogTags.description: Notes with one of these tags are listed as blog posts on the home page.

mapTags.description: Notes with one of these tags are listed as maps of content.

flashcardTags.description: Notes with one of these tags turn `Q::A` and `?` cards into flashcards.

timelineTags.description: Notes with one of these tags are timeline events, dated by `date` when they have no `start`.

ratingScale.description: Highest `rating` a note can have: ratings are drawn as that many stars.

footer.description: Columns of links in the footer: a heading to a list of entries written like `nav`. A heading to a URL is a single link instead; such links share one column without a heading.

poweredBy.description: A small "grown with datme" line, with its sprout, at the end of the footer.

nav.description: Main menu, in order: built-in pages, notes (by wikilink target) or plain URLs.

sidebar.description: Shortcuts at the top of the left sidebar, with the same kinds of entry as `nav`.

history.description: A page per note showing how it grew, from its git history. Off by default: it publishes what was later deleted. `history: false` in a note opts it out.

action.description: Where the form posts, e.g. a Mailchimp, ConvertKit or listmonk URL.

topicField.description: Name of a hidden field carrying the topic (folder:…, tag:…), if the service takes one.

subscribe.description: A form to get new notes by email, under notes and on folder and tag pages.

hide.description: Frontmatter keys left out of a note's properties block, on top of the built-in ones.

show.description: When set, the only frontmatter keys a properties block may show; any other key stays home.

types.description: Note types (the part after conventions.typePrefix): an icon and an optional label.

domain.description: The webmention.io account; defaults to the host of site.url.

webmentions.description: Receive webmentions through webmention.io and show them under each note.

types.description: Note types (from tags like type/composition) that keep their line breaks.

lineBreaks.description: Keep single line breaks, as Obsidian does by default; for poems and lyrics.

scheme.description: Colour scheme before the reader picks one with the toggle; auto follows their system.

accent.description: Accent colour of links and highlights; one value, or one per colour scheme.

fonts.description: Font families for headings and UI, reading text and code: from Google Fonts, unless a theme pack ships them.

d2.description: D2 theme ids of ```d2 diagrams, unless a diagram picks its own.

preset.description: A theme pack the values above override: a folder of the vault, or a datme-theme-* package.

css.description: A stylesheet in the vault, loaded after datme's own.

count.description: How many related notes to suggest under each note; 0 turns them off.

mentions.description: List notes that name this one without linking to it.

threshold.description: Cosine similarity from which two notes count as related, 0 to 1.

semantic.description: Also suggest notes similar in meaning, from embeddings computed on this machine at build time (needs

models.description: Language (or its base, as vi for vi-VN) to the model that speaks it.

folders.description: Vault folders whose notes get audio.

frontmatter.description: Frontmatter values that give a note audio.

tts.description: Read notes aloud in the author's voice at build time, one model per language.

topics.description: Group notes into topics from the embeddings of related.semantic, for the graph and /stats: true picks how many from the number of notes, a number sets it, false turns topics off.

stackedPages.description: Offer the stacked-notes mode, where links open side by side.

depth.description: Links the local graph of a note follows: 1 for its own links, 2 for theirs too; readers can switch.

view.description: How the global graph opens: flat, or laid out in space and turned by dragging; readers can switch.

optimize.description: Resize raster images into WebP copies and let browsers pick the smallest that fits.

widths.description: Widths of the resized copies, in pixels; only those below the original are made.

placeholders.description: Show a tiny blurred copy of each image while it loads.

keepMetadata.description: Publish original images with their EXIF, XMP and IPTC (camera, time, GPS position) instead of without.

meaning.description: Offer readers to search by meaning too: their browser downloads the model of related.semantic (about 120 MB, once) and blends closeness in meaning with the words.

search.description: Search engine of the site: minisearch loads every note's text at once, which suits most gardens; pagefind indexes the built pages and loads only what a query needs, for large ones.

linkPreviews.description: Turn a paragraph that is only a URL into a card with the page's title and image.

structure.description: Notices about the shape of the garden: orphan notes, dead ends and hubs.

layouts.description: Notices suggesting a layout for notes and folders whose text or properties look like one.

passwords.description: Warnings for passwords that are easy to guess, or written in notes of a vault kept in git.

archiveDeadLinks.description: Point links that `datme check --external` found dead at the Internet Archive's copy.

glossary.description: Link the first mention of a term (a note tagged type/term) to its note.

darkTiles.description: Tiles drawn for the dark theme; without them the light tiles are inverted.

map.description: Tiles of the map page, for notes with a `location`.

bibliography.description: BibTeX files, relative to the vault, that [@key] citations are looked up in.

outdated.description: Tell readers when a note has not been updated for this many years; `outdated: false` in a note opts it out. Home and daily notes never get it.

hide.description: Garden health indicators left off /stats, for authors who prefer not to publish them.

offline.description: Make the site installable and keep the pages a reader opened available offline.

ogImages.description: Generate social preview images for the home page and for notes without a banner.

neighbours.description: Other datme gardens, by a short name: `[[name:Note]]` links to a note of one of them.

activitypub.description: Let the fediverse find the garden: `bridgy` hands it to Bridgy Fed, which people can follow; `{ username }` publishes only a static actor and outbox, found but not followable. Needs site.url.

oembed.description: Let other sites embed a card of each public note, by oEmbed; needs site.url.

llms.description: Publish /llms.txt and a markdown copy of every public note, for readers and tools that want text.

askAi.description: Chat assistants a note's markdown menu offers to open it in; needs llms and site.url.

headers.description: Write a _headers file (Netlify, Cloudflare Pages) with safe defaults and caching; `false` skips it. `csp: true` adds a Content-Security-Policy built from the features in use.

redirects.description: Write a _redirects file (Netlify, Cloudflare Pages) with 301s for aliases and old URLs.

cname.description: Write a CNAME file with the host of site.url, for GitHub/GitLab Pages custom domains.

iterations.description: PBKDF2 rounds for notes with a `password`; higher is slower to unlock and to brute-force.

style.description: notebook: index cards on dotted paper; classic: the quiet serif blog look; garden: tiles sized by maturity, recently tended first; herbarium: notes as pressed specimens; manuscript: a book page with notes in its margin; lacquer: vermilion, black and gold leaf; zine: a cut-and-paste photocopied zine; atlas: an old atlas, each top folder a region; catalog: a library card catalogue with call numbers; eink: an e-reader's grey page, turned page by page if the reader likes; paddy: the garden as terraced rice fields.

classic.description: Folders whose notes use the other style, e.g. long-form writing.

folders.description: A style per folder, subfolders included, e.g. { Writing: classic }.

tags.description: A style per tag, nested tags included, e.g. { poem: classic }; a note's first matching tag wins.

stages.description: A style per growth stage, a key of `stages`, e.g. { 01_Fleeting: notebook }; after tags, before folders.

languages.description: A site-wide style per language (or its base, as vi for vi-VN), used instead of `style` on its pages.

schedule.description: Site-wide styles for days of the year, from and to included (a range may wrap the year): the first entry covering the day of the build replaces `style` and `languages`.

stream.description: Folders of short notes whose page shows each note in full, newest first, like a feed.

seasons.description: The garden style's colours follow the season of the build, and of the reader's day once the page opens: true for the northern hemisphere, or { hemisphere: south }.

readerSwitch.description: Styles readers can pick from the View menu instead of the page's own; true for every site-wide style.

strings.description: Per-language overrides of UI strings, e.g. { en-US: { blog: Posts } }.
